title: Hello!
text:
Hi, I’m Reinout
I’m a 2nd-year Master’s student at UHasselt in Statistics & Data Science, with a focus on Bioinformatics. My main interests are programming, data science/visualization and bioinformatics (microbiome and genetics). I also know how to code in JavaScript and react, so I am comfortable with html files, the command line, and working on bigger projects using Github.
In my free time, I like to:
- Go to the gym
- Cook and experiment in the kitchen
- Play the mouth harmonica
- Learn about horses and other random topics
You can also find me online: GitHub | LinkedIn
